changelog.note: Initial capture as user 1 on Asta with full access. Only QA-AUTO people, team members and dashboards are created and removed through the UI and then deleted forever from the CRM trash; the existing companies, people, deals, notes, tasks, team and the CRM itself are never changed. The Setup tab (data model, fields, connections, Archive and Move to Trash of the CRM) and the dashboard Six checks actions are only listed. Record counts are live data and never asserted.
